name: @deepsea/session-introspect
description: DeepSea plugin: transcript_* tools that let an agent read other agents' session transcripts (find by workspace/title, per-turn outline, timeline, per-tool error/latency stats, grep, raw events, joined exports) over ctx.sessionQuery, locally or, with `remote`, on another instance over the tailnet (the same plugin serves /api/deepsea-session-introspect/v1 there).

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/gen-tool-docs.mjs --check
